findings.problem: Grammatically fine, but pairing a house with coffee is an odd mix that nobody would naturally say, so it doesn't work as a model sentence.
findings.fix: example.target: Er hat ein Haus mit Garten. / example.en: He has a house with a garden.

back.example: He has a house and I have coffee.

note: sameAs is correctly null because this is a phrase card, though the Spanish card tener-have covers the same verb if a picture is wanted elsewhere.
